title: Private Niagara Falls Tour from Toronto
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the majestic Niagara Falls in style with a private luxury tour from Toronto. Enjoy a comfortable ride in a premium vehicle, complete with a professional chauffeur who will ensure a seamless experience. The tour includes stops at iconic sights like Horseshoe Falls and Table Rock, with flexible itineraries tailored to your preferences. Optional visits to charming Niagara-on-the-Lake and local wineries enhance your journey, making it perfect for couples, families, or business travelers. Experience the beauty of one of Canada’s most famous destinations at your own pace.

- Private luxury vehicle with professional chauffeur for your comfort
- Flexible itinerary including stops at Niagara Falls and scenic locations
- Optional visits to wineries and Niagara-on-the-Lake for a unique experience
- Tour duration typically 6–8 hours with hotel or airport pickup available
